Campus ChampionshipSports Week 2026 Inauguration

Sports Week 2026 — Day 1 Highlights

October 12, 2026
|
Zerh Karez Campus, University of Loralai, Loralai

The University of Loralai proudly commenced Sports Week 2026 on October 12, 2026, with great enthusiasm and active participation from students, faculty members, and administrative staff. The opening day featured exciting competitions in Table Tennis, Badminton, and Volleyball, bringing together different departments in a vibrant atmosphere of teamwork, discipline, and healthy competition. Prof. Dr. Adil Zaman Kasi, Pro-Vice Chancellor, formally inaugurated Sports Week 2026 by playing a ball during a cricket match and subsequently visited the ongoing sporting activities, appreciated the dedication of participants, and encouraged students and faculty to actively engage in sports. He emphasized the importance of teamwork, discipline, physical fitness, and sportsmanship in university life. Dr. Abdul Samad, Dean, Faculty of Basic, Social and Management Sciences, played an important role in supporting and encouraging the sporting activities, contributing significantly to student participation, interdepartmental engagement, and a positive sporting environment. Mr. Sher Hassan, Assistant Sports Officer, played a vital role in coordinating and managing the sporting activities, ensuring the smooth conduct of the opening day's competitions.

PCB Talent Hunt Program — Inter-School Championship

October 2026
|
University of Loralai Cricket Ground, Zerh Karez Campus

A thrilling Inter-School Championship match under the PCB Talent Hunt Program was played at the University of Loralai Cricket Ground between Zawia Public School Loralai and Noorani Public School Loralai. A high-level University delegation led by Worthy Vice Chancellor Engr. Prof. Dr. Ehsanullah Kakar, along with Registrar Dr. Khalid Khan, Dean Dr. Abdul Samad Kakar, Director QEC Dr. Naqeebullah Jogezai, Director Student Affairs Mr. Hidayatullah, Director Sports Mr. Sher Hassan Khan Jogezai, Mr. Shabbir Ahmad Usmani, and HOD English Mr. Asghar Khan visited the ground, interacted with the young players, and took group photographs. The young cricketers were also briefed on UOLI academic programs and athletic facilities.

Prime Minister Youth Sports League — Table Tennis at MCKRU Sibi

November 2023
|
Mir Chakar Khan Rind University (MCKRU), Sibi, Balochistan

The Directorate of Physical Education & Sports, University of Loralai successfully organized the Prime Minister Youth Sports League Table Tennis Talent Hunt Trials at Mir Chakar Khan Rind University (MCKRU), Sibi. As the designated organizing university for the regional zone, UOLI led the registration, tournament draw, refereeing, and awards ceremony, discovering top male and female table tennis athletes across the Sibi division.

October 2024
|
Zerh Karez Campus Stadium & Indoor Arena, University of Loralai
